name: Lavender Classroom
description: Ta'limiy va iliq uslub: lavender fon, sariq aksentlar, yirik o'qiladigan kartalar va bosqichma-bosqich tushuntirishlar. Dars, seminar va o'quv taqdimotlari uchun.
prompt_guidance: Explain concepts in a friendly educational sequence with definitions, examples, and practical classroom use.
Use short learning-oriented section titles that are clear for students.
Prefer process sections for methods, learning paths, and step-by-step explanations.
Use tables for method comparisons, age groups, outcomes, or assessment types when natural.
Avoid overly technical wording unless the topic requires it.
